bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating generated story topics and character descriptions based on the perceived gender of a given character, and comparing associations of brilliance between male and female characters using specific prompts.

Computing sentiment scores of generated outputs using race placeholders embedded in prompts, and evaluating pain management treatment refusal rates across different racial groups using a medical Q&A dataset (Q-Pain).
Analyzing the association of specific religious terms (e.g., 'Muslim') with negative concepts (e.g., 'terrorist') and measuring the likelihood of these terms inducing violent model outputs.
